integrity: Analytical proof of global interval, unique regular extremizer, and boundary limits; exact symbolic identities and five independent Monte Carlo geometries checked with the included executable. Finite tests do not establish an infinite universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Nondegenerate Euclidean equifacial tetrahedra only. The isotropic translation-invariant law on affine planes is conditioned on intersection; central sections and independent-uniform-normal-then-offset samples are different laws. Historical priority is provisionally assessed, not independently certified.
title: Sharp affine-plane section probability for every equifacial tetrahedron
